caption: Shoot, and drink the matter your foes leave behind.
alt: On Nacre, the pearl world, the droplet fires glowing beads into a swarm of pearl mites and chrome tumblers, while bright matter from the foes it broke flies back into it.

caption: Every change grows on your body: wings, crowns, eyes.
alt: On Hydrargyra, the mercury sea, a grown droplet fights between two hydras. Its body carries what it became: a gold halo, glass lens wings, a crown of glass shards, a third eye and chrome spines.

caption: Cathedra, the glass garden, one of five small worlds.
alt: A wide view of Cathedra, a glass world under a glass ring, with crystal spires and three glowing jellies near its top. The droplet stands small among the crystals.

caption: Each world has a heart, and every heart fights back.
alt: On Ferrum Dunes, the Lodemother, a world-heart of spinning gold rings around a magnetic core, rises over the droplet, which stands its ground and faces it.

caption: Launch, then glide between worlds through rings of light.
alt: Out in space between worlds, the droplet glides through a large ring of light, trailing colour, with more rings leading on to the next world.

caption: At the Eclipse, the droplet becomes a star.
alt: At the Eclipse, the droplet has grown into a glass star. Rays of light burst out of it, and the worlds it woke circle it on gold orbits.
